cost_scope: Measured stage/function wall times, not complete old+new end-to-end model cost. Source first GAP pass has only total timing. Subsequent extraction JSON separates native CPU/IO, mask/packing (including input tensor transfer), synchronized backbone wall, response/transfer wall and serialization. training_costs.csv separates optimization plus validation from cached adaptation. No hardware-profiler claim.
coverage_image_observations: Actual vs median template clearly differs at small/large/slender targets; square example has disabled VH; clipped example retains insufficient exterior coverage instead of changing rho. These are geometric readout supports, not pure RF/physical segmentation.
posttraining_case_analysis_owner: Independent agent/main, using saved summaries and models; no duplicate analysis directory or FINDINGS authored here.
scope: Fixed historical development cohort; no new independent confirmation; no temperature/window/head search or appended training.
